crm_notes: 2/12 Kickoff call — legal + infra. Customer: national compliance shop supporting 1500 law firm users; workflows: document review + regulatory response.
Primary ask: scalable RAG for document discovery across 20M+ docs (scanned PDFs + OCR) with embeddings + reranking. Target P50 latency for top-K retrieval+rerank < 150ms for short queries.
POC scope: index 10M doc corpus, run retrieval + candidate embeddings, then cross-encoder rerank on top 50 candidates. Measure cost/query and tail latency.
Quote from CISO: 'We need airtight audit trails and a retention policy that meets subpoena/e-discovery — 7 years minimum.'
Data residency: must keep custodial copy inside US regions; private control plane or VPC required. No third-party ML model telemetry leaving VPC.
Model preference: open/quantized models if private; fallback to Redwood-verified hosted variants for burst. Want recommendations for quantization and batching to reduce cost.
Cost sensitivity: procurement is evaluating ARR delta vs in-house vector infra. Goal: <$0.30 per query at 1000 QPS-equivalent steady state (amortized).
Technical constraint: OCR pipeline produces noisy text; embeddings must be robust — need stopword handling and chunking strategy. Interested in prefix/KV caching for common queries.
Security review items submitted 2/18; awaiting SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details. SE workshop scheduled to tune reranker on PII-heavy docs.
Internal note: customer leans away from SaaS-only due to litigation hold requirements. Private deployment plus long-term retention addon looks likely path to close.
